items.title: Willie "Old Man" Parker Interview, 1958-11-07
items.q: Sheikho played the baritone in the brass band and played the trombone orchestra. Yeah, I was Sheikho. Oh boy, he's a good baritone player.

ctx.x: Oh, I see. And did you have a baritone going?

Oh yeah, Sheikho, that's right. Sheikho played a baritone. He played the baritone in the brass band and played the trombone orchestra. Yeah, I was Sheikho. Oh boy, he's a good baritone player. He died in this boy. Oh, his daughter made a friend of a nice trombone, a baritone. And that boy pawned that instrument. I want the ticket. I said, give me the ticket and let me get it out. I said, you can get it any time you want. All that good instrument like that get lost. Five dollars he got on that home. Well, he…
What's your name? Tell me a gentleman your name.
